Alrighty, alrighty! Let me spin you a yarn, straight from the barnyard and seasoned with a dash of my old-timey charm. Now, this one's about a certain chicken, you see, who had quite the unique personality... or shall we say, character!

So there's this old chicken, and this chicken's behind was as red as a ripe tomato, and just as round! And this chicken, well, she had a bit of a habit. Every time she'd lay an egg, she'd paint a smiley face on it, you see! And the other barnyard animals, they'd just chuckle and shake their heads, for that egg was always a surefire pick-me-up, brightening their day!
